name: coordinator-planned-anchoring
body:
Anchoring note for the session coordinator. `solution.container.mutation-coordinator` and its components (`session-routing`, `session-lifecycle`, `write-through-projection`) are now REALIZED — the branch scan replaced the planned anchors with real code and each node carries `implemented-by` edges, so the spine resolves: the coordinator to `apg.session`, `apg.session.Coordinator`, `.serve`, and `.handle_mutation`; `session-lifecycle` to `.start`, `.end`, and `.reclaim_stale_socket`; `session-routing` to `apg.cmd_query` and `.forward_mutation`; `write-through-projection` to `apg.layers.write_project` and `apg.plan_cmd.write_through`. `solution.component.mutation-db-decoupling` is anchored to `apg.artifacts.code_universes`, `apg.artifacts.code_universes_from_export`, `apg.artifacts.reingest_layers`, `apg.git.reanchor_scan_meta`, and `apg.layers.write_project`.

The coordinator is a MANDATORY deliverable, not a plan option (session-mutation-coordinator): the plan MUST realize the coordinator and its solution nodes, and the verify/coverage gate treats them as in-scope. The `prefer-structural-fix` law no longer makes them optional — it requires serialization of the whole durable sequence and justifies the coordinator by amortization of the DB open (never of visibility: projection deltas are applied write-through). The transparent direct path is additionally serialized by the extended flock (evaluate-fix-ladder option a).
